notes: Asset manifest. Everything listed under 'rig' is bundled and verified to load. 'audio.optionalFiles' are NOT bundled (copyrighted film audio); drop licensed files at those paths and they override the synthesized versions automatically.

rig.source: three.js examples (examples/models/gltf/Soldier.glb), Mixamo 'Vanguard' character + Idle/Walk/Run clips
rig.license: Mixamo content: free for personal & commercial use inside projects; do not redistribute the raw file as a standalone asset. Replace with your own licensed model for production.
rig.bones: mixamorig:* (Hips, Spine..Spine2, Head, RightArm, RightForeArm, RightHand, legs)
rig.note: STAND-IN: one rig is reused for all four characters. Faces/costumes are procedural 3D props parented to the real bones. Combat motion (slashes, parries, blocks, dodges, defeats) is authored in code on top of the skeleton (2-bone IK + bone offsets). No licensed Star Wars character models are bundled.

procedural.vaderHelmet: src/helmet.js — original low-poly 3D helmet built in code (no licensed model). Replace with a licensed GLB by loading it in src/actors.js (buildHelmet())
procedural.sabers: src/actors.js — hilt + 4-layer emissive blade, parented to the RightHand bone, with a PointLight
procedural.environment: src/world.js — reactor chamber, shaft, columns, fog, light shafts, dust, sparks, Force lightning

audio.engine: Web Audio API (src/audio.js) — all sounds synthesized at runtime, original, not film recordings
synthesized: original dark orchestral-style ambient score (not the Imperial March)
